name: BALROG NetHack (5 episodes)

assignment.task: Official BALROG environment (text mode). The first observation contains BALROG's own instruction prompt with the list of valid actions; output exactly one valid action per turn.
assignment.observation: Text only: BALROG's current-observation text (language description of the surroundings, inventory/status and the map as rendered by BALROG's language wrapper).

actions.action: One action name from BALROG's action list (an invalid action defaults to BALROG's default action, with BALROG's feedback).

contract: Exactly one action name from the BALROG action list per turn.

player.invalidResponses: H0 used structured output (one schema-valid submit_action per response); a refusal or a response without an action was retried with the same request, without a reprompt.

notes: BALROG set nethack; BALROG step limits per env from balrog/config/config.yaml.

NetHack reads the system date at game start (phase of the moon, Friday the 13th). H0 started these episodes between 2026-10-11T03:34:13Z and 2026-10-11T03:34:28Z, during a new moon (first message 'Be careful!  New moon tonight.'). For exact reproduction run the bridge with the clock set to that time (e.g. libfaketime); on other dates the first message differs and moon-dependent rules can change. tools/replay_verify.mjs on 2026-10-14 reproduced every step but the first message.
